subject: learning/explicit-rebase-reconciliation
statement: After a rebase, a replacement that explicitly reconciles both the current mainline head and its superseded ancestor admits the complete lineage without treating the deliberately replaced ancestor as an unreconciled moved head.
intent: Keep explicit reconciliation usable without regenerating unrelated immutable branch records.
rationale: The Lavish removal rebase reproduced a false effective-set-moved finding for a new plangate anchor superseding both branch and current mainline anchors. Omitted current heads, dependency-only links, revoked ancestors, and invalid relation chains remain refused.
